name: wiki-decisions
description: > Optional decision layer: hand small closed judgments (is this page relevant, does this source update or duplicate that page, do these two sections conflict) to a System One decision model (TypeSafe Jev) instead of reading pages to decide. Off by default. Use when the user says "/wiki-decisions", "enable the decision layer", "use Jev", "gate my search results", "triage this ingest", "screen for contradictions", or asks how the decision layer works or what it sends. Not a writer: it never answer
author: Ar9av
